Chat rules

Cooldown: one smash per person per gap. Extra messages still fill Chat Heat and the Iron Gate. The same text from the same person within 30 s earns no point.

Saved automatically at each daily reset (and on “Reset board now”), last 14 days. Real chat only: demo and fake chat never count. “Copy today's top 10” gives a ready text for a community post.

Aura & Limit Break

The breaker's aura grows with Chat Heat: Lv1 glow · Lv2 flames (33%) · Lv3 lightning (66%) · 100% = LIMIT BREAK (fire mode + speed lines + impact flash + manga text).

Mascots (Volt & Blaze)

They pop up bottom-left while a tower is in play (the prompt card steps aside), never during intro/results. Thank-yous: Volt on new subs, the sub goal, new members and gifted memberships · Blaze on the like goal, Super Chats / Stickers and Jewels (paid ones only in Monetized mode). Nothing here says “subscribe to win”.
